subject: Billing rhythm synchronization proposal & early-settlement options
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@luminexsystems.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning billing rhythm for onboarding

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get Redwood live for a subset of our API traffic. Before we kick off PO creation I wanted to confirm two items on payment terms and the invoice cadence:

1) Our standard procurement process issues POs on a monthly cadence and typically requests Net 45 for new vendors (we can make exceptions for strategic partners).
2) We have an internal early-pay program (2% for payment within 10 days) and would like to explore whether Redwood offers an early-settlement discount or enrollment path during onboarding.

Can you confirm Redwood's default net terms for new vendor onboarding and whether you can support a hybrid cadence (monthly PO issuance aligned to our month-end and Net 45)? If a different net (Net 30/Net 60) is required, please outline the options.

Also attached is our vendor onboarding form for your intake team — please let us know if anything on the form needs clarification.

Appreciate your help,

— Elena
Elena Morales
Vendor Manager, Luminex Systems
procurement@luminexsystems.com
Attachment: Luminex_Onboarding_Form.pdf
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@luminexsystems.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning billing rhythm for onboarding

Elena —

Thanks for sending the form and the context. Quick answers up front: Redwood's standard commercial onboarding uses Net 30 by default for hosted customers; however, we routinely support custom net terms (Net 45 / Net 60) for enterprise procurement and can enroll vendors in an early-pay/discount program on a case-by-case basis.

Proposed path for Luminex:
- Option A (recommended): Accept monthly PO cadence aligned to your month-end + Net 45 on invoices. Our billing system can map to the PO number and accept the monthly invoice batch.
- Option B: Standard Net 30 on our side; Luminex continues to issue monthly POs. We can offer a 1.5% early-payment credit if you commit to 10-day settlement.
- Option C: Net 60 for longer cash conversion — eligible only with a signed annual commitment (discount tiers in attached spreadsheet).

Next steps I propose: 1) we complete the onboarding intake (I reviewed the attached form and added a couple internal notes), 2) my team will prepare a short PO/Invoice mapping checklist so your AP team can route invoices to the right ledger and 3) Marissa (cc'd, Billing Ops) will coordinate the early-pay enrollment pilot if you want to test the 2%/10-day option.

I've attached a draft "Proposed_Netterm_Tiers.xlsx" with the three options and the financial impact per quarter. Can you confirm which option you'd like to pilot and whether you can return a signed PO (or DocuSign envelope) referencing Redwood's vendor id? If helpful I can loop David (rev ops) to confirm invoice header requirements.

Best,

Irene Choi
Senior Director, Procurement Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Proposed_Netterm_Tiers.xlsx

---

Irene — thanks for the clear options. We reviewed internally with AP and Finance. A few clarifications/questions from our side:

• We prefer Option A (monthly PO + Net 45) but need the invoice to show a clear PO number field and a separate service period (start/end) so our GL mapping works. Can Redwood support a service-period line on the invoice?
• For the early-pay program, our procurement team can enroll Redwood in our vendor early-pay portal once we have a signed enrollment form. Could you confirm the discount math exactly (is the 2% unconditional or tiered based on total spend)?
• We will upload the onboarding form; expect a signed PO (PO #78912) next week. Can you confirm if Redwood can accept PO PDFs via procurement@redwood.ai and whether PO-specific routing (billing ops queue) is required?

Attached: signed onboarding form and a sample PO template from our ERP.

Thanks,
— Elena
Attachment: Signed_Onboarding_Form.pdf; Sample_PO_Template.pdf

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@luminexsystems.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning billing rhythm for onboarding

Elena / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the signed onboarding form + PO template. Confirming final plan based on your feedback:

1) Enrollment: We will onboard Luminex as a monthly-invoice vendor tied to PO #78912. Redwood billing will include a PO number field and a service period line item (start/end) as requested.

2) Net terms: We'll run Option A — Net 45 for the first 90 days of the engagement. At the 90-day mark we'll review consumption and either keep Net 45 or move to Net 30 based on the agreed thresholds in the spreadsheet.

3) Early-pay: Redwood is happy to be enrolled in Luminex's early-pay portal. The 2% early-pay discount is unconditional for payments made within 10 days on the pilot. If the vendor pilot scales we can discuss a tiered structure tied to quarterly spend. Marissa will reach out with the enrollment form and technical contact for the portal.

Action items:
- Marissa: send onboarding checklist and the AP routing document (by Mon, 30 Aug).
- David: confirm exact invoice header format and sample XML export for your ERP (by Tue, 31 Aug).
- Elena: please route PO #78912 and the signed onboarding form to procurement@redwood.ai once your legal team completes any final review.

I'll follow up with a short confirmation note and open a ticket in our vendor portal with the attachments. Thanks all — looking forward to a smooth onboarding.

Best regards,

Irene Choi
Senior Director, Procurement Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0194
Attachment: Signed_PO_78912.pdf
